basic_profile.bio: Hailing from upstate New York, I'm a mechanical engineer with a penchant for vintage cars, particularly the Porsche 944. I spend my days designing efficient systems and my evenings tinkering in the garage or exploring the mysteries of the universe through documentaries and Reddit threads. A proud Syracuse University alum, I bleed orange and occasionally contribute to discussions about campus life. In my downtime, I enjoy gardening and experimenting with hydroponic setups. I'm in a long-term relationship and often stay up late, catching up on the latest posts and discoveries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering from Syracuse University, I've spent over a decade in the automotive industry, specializing in brake systems. My interest in extraterrestrial life and evolution is more of a hobby, fueled by countless hours of self-study and participation in relevant subreddits.
